title: Concrete-source branches out of the decision stages (D5)
summary: `AuthorityStage` stops branching on `FolderSource`/`DatabaseSource`: FolderSource role-class binding moves to core source preparation (next to the Relation binding), automatic-role admission reads an internal capability instead of `instanceof FolderSource`, and contribution reading is delegated to the read coordinator, which keeps its internal database mechanics (D5). An arch test forbids concrete-source `instanceof` in stages, query composition and Visibility.
why: Phase contract: concrete-source branches leave decision/query semantics; the read coordinator keeps snapshot/fence mechanics internally (D5). Hard risk (I21/I22): moving the DatabaseSource read path must not change snapshot acquisition, physical-handle grouping, fenced re-reads, dirty-read rejection or handle release; any change of read order is a defect — keep the same calls in the same order, only relocated.

include: `Authorization\Pipeline\Stages\AuthorityStage`: no `instanceof FolderSource|DatabaseSource|RelationSource|GateSource`; `bindRoleClasses` happens once where the panel's sources are prepared for a compiled catalog (`Sources\PanelSources` / `Panels\PanelRegistry`, where `RelationSource` binding already happens), and the calls in `AuthorityStage` and `ReadAttempt` are removed

Automatic non-grantable roles are admitted only from a source implementing the new core-internal marker interface `AzGuard\Sources\Internal\EvaluatesAutomaticRoles` (no members), which `Sources\Folder\FolderSource` implements; its oracle row (`core / internal / new / P3`) is added by #oracle

`AuthorityStage::readSource()` delegates the DatabaseSource snapshot read to `Authorization\ReadAttempt` (or the source's own method reached through it); `ReadAttempt` keeps its concrete-source branches (coordinator, D5)

Arch test in `tests/Arch/AuthorizationArchTest.php`: no `instanceof` of a concrete source class in `Authorization/Pipeline/Stages/*`, `Authorization/Query/*`, `Authorization/Internal/Query/*`, `Authorization/Visibility.php`
exclude: Restructuring `ReadAttempt`/`ReadSessions` beyond receiving the moved calls
ChangePipeline/diagnostics/commands writer checks (writer is core storage by D10)

reads.why: Rules every P3 item follows (reference + amendments win, no shims, placement, oracle, allowlists, snapshots, migration lines, tests)
Exact validation commands, PHP 8.4, driver ports, composer update rule
Chain C stage order and the read coordinator role
I21/I22 consistency and budget invariants that must not move
Coordinator that keeps DatabaseSource mechanics; bindRoleClasses calls ~405/~488

rules: The read path performs the same queries in the same order: `tests/Feature/Authorization` query-count/budget tests and `DecisionSetSnapshotTest`, `ReadSessionLifecycleTest` stay green unchanged.
The marker row is listed in knowledge/p3-execution#amendments.

validation.cmd: php -d memory_limit=1G vendor/bin/pest tests/Feature/Authorization tests/Feature/Sources tests/Feature/Roles tests/Feature/Visibility tests/Unit/Authorization --fail-on-skipped
php -d memory_limit=1G vendor/bin/pest tests/Feature/Parity tests/Feature/InactiveCost tests/Regression --fail-on-skipped
composer analyse && composer lint:check && composer refactor:check && composer api:check
export PGSQL_PORT=25432 MYSQL_PORT=23306 MARIADB_PORT=23307 && composer test:db -- pgsql --parallel && composer test:db -- mysql --parallel && composer test:db -- mariadb --parallel
export PGSQL_PORT=25432 MYSQL_PORT=23306 MARIADB_PORT=23307 && composer test:db -- pgsql --engines && composer test:db -- mysql --engines && composer test:db -- mariadb --engines

result.notes: FolderSource roles bound in PanelSources::of(catalog:) (PrepareStage, Visibility, AuthorityStage fallback); readSource moved to ReadAttempt with unchanged call order; EvaluatesAutomaticRoles internal. V1-V7 green: composer test 4753, drivers --parallel and --engines on pgsql/mysql/mariadb.
deviations: V1 adjusted (tests/Unit/Roles instead of the missing tests/Feature/Roles); PrepareStage.php and Visibility.php are outside task_files (committed with --path). V2-V5 shared batch runs.
